---
title: "Life Expectancy and GDP per Capita"
---

This page explores how life expectancy relates to GDP per capita, and how that relationship changes across time.

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv("gapminder.csv")

# Scatter: life expectancy vs GDP per capita, colored by year (simple approach)
years = sorted(df["year"].unique())
sample_years = [1952, 1977, 2007]  # show a few snapshots for readability

plt.figure()
for y in sample_years:
    sub = df[df["year"] == y]
    plt.scatter(sub["gdp_per_capita"], sub["life_expectancy"], label=str(y), alpha=0.7)

plt.xscale("log")
plt.xlabel("GDP per Capita (log scale)")
plt.ylabel("Life Expectancy")
plt.title("Life Expectancy vs GDP per Capita (selected years)")
plt.legend()
plt.show()
